meta.title: Yangiyer Flour Trading — first-grade wheat flour, 50 kg
meta.description: Yangiyer Flour Trading LLC is a family-owned flour mill in Yangiyer, Uzbekistan, operating since 1991. First-grade wheat flour in 50 kg bags, wholesale.

hero.title: First-grade wheat flour. In 50 kg bags, wholesale.
hero.lead: Our mill in Yangiyer has been making flour for bakeries and distributors since 1991.

brands.title: Four brands, one grade
brands.lead: Every bag holds 50 kilograms of first-grade wheat flour.

about.title: About the company
about.p1: Yangiyer Flour Trading LLC is an independent, family-owned company. It has operated in Yangiyer, Syrdarya region, since 1991.
about.p2: The mill was built to produce wheat flour from first to third grade. With more than 30 years in wholesale and production, we make sure buyers get their loads on time, every day.

process.title: Production
process.lead: Wheat is tested in our laboratory on arrival, then goes to the mill. Finished flour is bagged and loaded onto rail wagons.

lab.title: Laboratory
lab.text: Incoming wheat is analysed in the laboratory.

milling.title: Milling
milling.text: Grain is ground and sifted on an automated line.

packing.title: Packing
packing.text: Flour is filled into 50 kg bags and sewn shut.

loading.title: Loading
loading.text: Bags are stacked in the warehouse and loaded onto rail wagons.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Short answers on grade, packaging and delivery. The rest we settle by phone.

items.q: Which flour grades do you produce?
items.a: The mill produces wheat flour from first to third grade. The SO‘FRA, MASHRAB, AL HAYOT and SALAM brands are first grade to GOST 26574-85.
Every brand comes in 50 kg bags. Bags are filled on the line, sewn shut and stacked in the warehouse.

items.q: Which countries do you deliver to?
items.a: We work across Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan, with a separate phone line in Kazakhstan. Large consignments ship by rail wagon. For other countries, send a request.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Enter the brand and number of bags in the form, or call us. The price depends on volume and delivery terms, so we confirm it by phone.

items.q: Where does the wheat come from?
items.a: MASHRAB and AL HAYOT are milled from Kazakh wheat. Every incoming lot is tested in the laboratory before it reaches the mill.

help.title: Need a quick answer?
help.text: On working days reach us by phone or Telegram — the number is one tap to copy.
